# Client Policy

This version defines a 30-second request timeout and assigns timeout guidance to
the platform team.

## Important assertions

- Clients use a 30-second timeout ([Client Policy claim](../topics/client-policy.md#claim-client-timeout-30-seconds)); heading "Timeout", lines 3-5.
